name: @amplerun/mcp

tools.name: get_agent_account_challenge
tools.description: Step 1 of 2. Returns an EIP-4361 (Sign-In with Ethereum) message for a wallet address this agent controls, valid five minutes, single use. Signing it accepts the AmpleRun Terms version it names. Sign the message exactly as returned with personal_sign (EIP-191), then call register_agent_account with message and signature. Never send a private key to any tool.

address.description: The agent's wallet address (0x...). Defaults to this server's wallet when it has one.

tools.name: register_agent_account
tools.description: Step 2 of 2. Opens an AmpleRun account for this AI agent, tagged as agent-created, with its wallet as the verified payout wallet, and returns an API key (shown once; keep it secret). The same wallet again returns the same account and a new key. There is no free credit: renting needs a deposit first. Pass message and signature from get_agent_account_challenge. scopes defaults to ["renter","host"].

vendor.description: Who made the agent or its model, e.g. "grok".

operator_contact.description: How to reach the person or business running this agent.

message.description: The challenge message, exactly as returned.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List published AmpleRun templates: pinned container images a rental runs, such as an inference server with fixed model weights or a PyTorch or Jupyter runtime. Returns each template's id, slug (template_id), name, kind, engine, minimum VRAM in bytes and minimum GPU count, plus next_cursor. Read-only; no API key needed. search_offers finds machines for a template.

kind.description: model: an inference server with pinned weights; classical: a general runtime; custom: other images.

gpu_vram_gib.description: Only templates that fit on a GPU with this much VRAM, in GiB (e.g. 24).

tools.name: probe_hf_model
tools.description: Reads a Hugging Face model's public metadata: pipeline, license, GGUF quantizations, estimated VRAM in bytes and the engine that would serve it. Use it before propose_model. Gated repos need a Hugging Face token on the account. Read-only; no API key needed.

repo.description: Hugging Face repo "owner/model" or a huggingface.co URL.

tools.name: propose_model
tools.description: Submits a Hugging Face repo or a custom OCI image as a draft template. It stays unpublished until an operator reviews it. Needs an API key on a verified account. Provide hf_repo or oci_image. Run probe_hf_model first to pick the engine.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search GPU machines that can be rented now on AmpleRun. gpu_model, gpu_count, max_rate_micro_per_hour and continent filter on the server; near lists one continent's machines first. min_vram_gib and region filter each fetched page here because the API has no such filters, so a page can return fewer than limit matches: scanned is how many offers were checked, and next_cursor continues. Prices are micro-units per hour for the whole machine, fee included; cheapest first. With template, each offer carries fit {fits, reason}. Read-only; no API key needed.

gpu_model.description: Case-insensitive part of the GPU model name, e.g. "4090" or "A100".

min_vram_gib.description: Minimum VRAM per GPU in GiB. Offers with unmeasured VRAM are excluded.

max_rate_micro_per_hour.description: Highest machine price per hour in micro-units, e.g. "500000" for 0.50 USDC/h.

region.description: Case-insensitive part of the host's cloud region, e.g. "us-east". Offers without a reported region are excluded.

gpu_count.description: Minimum number of GPUs in the machine.

continent.description: Only machines on this continent, for low latency: eu, as, na, sa, af, oc, an, or "americas" (na + sa). Machines with an unknown location are excluded.

near.description: List this continent's machines first, then the rest (nothing is excluded).

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a rental without committing: creates a free, non-binding AmpleRun quote (valid 60 seconds; nothing is reserved or charged) for a template on an offer, capped by budget_micro. Returns the quote exactly as the API sent it plus fee_split: the most the rental can cost and how that divides into the platform fee (platform_fee_bps) and the host's share. Needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY with the renter scope. create_rental quotes again when it reserves, so this step is optional.

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

duration_limit_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds (60 to 31536000), e.g. 7200 for two hours.

budget_micro.description: Spending cap in micro-units of the asset ("1000000" = 1 USDC). The rental is never charged more than this.

asset.description: Balance to pay from. USDC when omitted.

tools.name: create_rental
tools.description: Rent a GPU on AmpleRun: quotes the template on the offer and reserves the machine in one step, holding up to budget_micro from the account balance. budget_micro is required and is a hard cap: the rental is never charged more, and metering starts only once the machine is verified ready. Returns rental_id, state, the quote, fee_split and the idempotency_key used; retrying with the same idempotency_key never creates a second rental. get_rental reports state and access. Spends money. Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

duration_limit_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds (60 to 31536000), e.g. 7200 for two hours.

budget_micro.description: Spending cap in micro-units of the asset ("1000000" = 1 USDC). The rental is never charged more than this.

ssh_public_key.description: Optional one-line OpenSSH public key (the .pub file). Omit for model/API-only usage; without a key, SSH access is off.

asset.description: Balance to pay from. USDC when omitted.

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Get one AmpleRun rental by rental_id: state, cumulative charge (micro-units), rate and funded-through time. While it is RUNNING (verified ready), and read-only for a limited window after STOPPED, also returns access: endpoints, SSH host-key fingerprint, a ready-made command and, for model templates, the endpoint's per-rental API key. Read-only. list_rentals finds rental ids.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: List the account's AmpleRun rentals with state, charge so far (micro-units), rate and funded-through time. Ordered by id, not by time; page with next_cursor. Read-only. get_rental gives details and access for one rental.

tools.name: stop_rental
tools.description: Stop an AmpleRun rental: ends the workload and its metering. Files inside the machine stay reachable read-only only for a limited retrieval window. Stopping again is harmless. Returns rental_id and the new state (STOPPING or a later state). Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

reason.default: stopped by an AI agent via @amplerun/mcp

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the AmpleRun account's USDC and USDT balances as micro-unit strings: spendable (available for new rentals), held by live rentals, pending, disputed and withdrawable, plus the last 30 days' spend. Read-only; needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY.

tools.name: get_deposit_address
tools.description: Get this AmpleRun account's own deposit address and the networks it is watched on (`networks`: Base first, plus any of Arbitrum, Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche the operator has switched on). The address is the same on every listed network. Send USDC or USDT (credited 1:1) or the network's own coin (ETH, POL, BNB, AVAX: credited in USD at the Chainlink price at finality minus `native.spread_bps`; `native.quote_micro_per_coin` is the live quote) from any wallet or exchange: no wallet linking, no transaction hash. Each deposit is credited once, after that network's finality (state SEEN, then CREDITED; HELD means over a balance cap and credited once there is room). Funds sent on a network not in `networks` are not credited. The address never changes; the first call creates it. Read-only otherwise; needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_withdrawal_addresses
tools.description: List the account's saved withdrawal addresses (network, address, label, state). withdraw pays only to a CONFIRMED one. An agent account's own registration wallet is saved from the start; a person adds others in their account (each confirmed by an emailed link). Read-only; needs AMPLERUN_API_KEY.

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw USDC or USDT from the balance to one of the account's saved (CONFIRMED) addresses on Base; any other address is refused (403) and nothing moves. amount_micro is an integer string ("1000000" = 1 USDC): what leaves the balance, at most the withdrawable balance and at least the minimum (5 USDC by default). A flat fee (0.5 USDC by default) is kept from it when it settles; the answer gives fee_micro and receive_micro. Returns withdrawal_id and state INTENT; it is paid automatically once checks pass. Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted.

tools.name: host_this_machine
tools.description: Mints a one-time enrollment token and returns the install command for the machine this agent runs on. On Linux the installer needs root; on a Mac it runs without sudo. The token is shown once. Ask the machine's owner before running it. Nothing is listed until the owner approves. Pass owner_account_id to enroll a machine onto an owner's fleet you were delegated.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: list_my_machines
tools.description: Machines registered to this host account, or to owner_account_id when that owner delegated machines:read.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: One machine, including its current offer. Requires the host scope.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: set_price
tools.description: Publishes the next offer version at rate_micro_per_hour, rounded up to the next whole cent (10000 micro-units). Quotas and the listing window stay as they are. A running rental keeps the rate it was quoted.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: list_machine
tools.description: Make this machine visible for rent. Requires the host scope and machines:listing when delegated.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: unlist_machine
tools.description: Hide this machine from new rentals. A rental already running is left alone.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: drain_machine
tools.description: Stop taking new rentals. The current rental can finish.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: machine_status
tools.description: Latest telemetry for a machine. Requires the host scope.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: get_idle_pool
tools.description: Read idle-pool opt-in, the latest workload status and credited USDC for this host's machines, or for owner_account_id when that owner delegated earnings:read. The credit is already in the host balance and withdraws the same way. Read-only. 404 while the idle pool is off.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: Earnings for this host account, or for owner_account_id when that owner delegated earnings:read. Read-only.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.description: Payout history for this host: amount, asset, state and time. Does not move funds and does not return a destination address.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: create_enrollment_token
tools.description: Mint a one-time enrollment token. The machine that redeems it is registered to this account, or to owner_account_id when delegated.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: approve_pairing
tools.description: Approve the code an installer printed. The machine is registered to this account, or to owner_account_id when delegated.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Get what it takes to top up the AmpleRun USDC balance by amount_micro with x402: the payment requirements, one per network the server accepts right now (Base, plus Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer where enabled; the facilitator pays the gas), each with its USDC contract, treasury payTo, amount and EIP-712 domain. A wallet signs them as an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization and repeats POST /api/v1/billing/x402/top-up with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (@amplerun/sdk does this with its x402 option). This server holds no wallet, so it pays nothing; an operator who configures AMPLERUN_MCP_WALLET_KEY_FILE and allows spending lets it pay.

amount_micro.description: Top-up amount in micro-USDC, e.g. "5000000" for 5 USDC.

tools.name: pay_for_rental
tools.description: Rent a GPU and pay any USDC shortfall with x402. If spendable USDC already covers budget_micro, the machine is reserved and nothing else is charged. Otherwise this returns the x402 requirements for the shortfall only. The payment is credited like a deposit, then the rental is reserved once that credit is spendable. The same idempotency_key never reserves twice, and the same payment cannot settle twice. Mainnet (eip155:8453) is offered only when the operator set X402_MAINNET_ENABLED. Base Sepolia is eip155:84532 (EIP-712 name USDC). Solana is not accepted. Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

duration_limit_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds (60 to 31536000), e.g. 7200 for two hours.

budget_micro.description: Spending cap in micro-units of the asset ("1000000" = 1 USDC). The rental is never charged more than this.

ssh_public_key.description: Optional one-line OpenSSH public key. Omit for model or API usage; SSH stays off.

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

instructions: AmpleRun rents GPUs from independent hosts, paid from a prepaid USDC or USDT balance. Money values are integer strings in micro-units: "1000000" is 1 USDC. Offer prices are per hour for the whole machine, fee included. Renting goes list_templates, search_offers, get_quote (optional), create_rental, get_rental; stop_rental ends a rental. No account yet? get_agent_account_challenge then register_agent_account opens one for this agent with a wallet signature, no email. host_this_machine mints an enrollment token and returns the install command. list_my_machines, set_price, list_machine and get_earnings manage a host fleet. Pass owner_account_id when an owner has delegated that fleet. top_up and pay_for_rental return the x402 payment requirements for USDC; this server has no wallet to pay them. pay_for_rental offers mainnet only when the operator set X402_MAINNET_ENABLED. top_up keeps the networks already offered. This server is read-only: create_rental, stop_rental and withdraw are refused. Refused: this AmpleRun MCP server is read-only. Restart it with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 in its environment to allow creating and stopping rentals.
